name: David McAllister - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its foreign policy priorities for the coming year. It asks the EU to keep supporting Ukraine against Russia's war and to hold Russia accountable, to push for peace in Gaza based on two states, and to stand firm against China's military pressure on Taiwan. It also wants the EU to work more closely with partners like the United States, the United Kingdom, India and Latin American countries, and to speak with one clearer voice abroad. The report is a set of recommendations; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament recommends priorities; the EU's foreign policy chief and member states decide.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, the EU's foreign service, and partner countries like Ukraine, Israel and China.
- **What happens next:** The foreign policy chief is asked to reply in writing to Parliament's requests.
